failures.description: smoke/agent-payment-abandonment timed out at 900 s because the Tilion browser provider lost the agent's session before request_payment_card, so no payment-card request was created
failures.evidence: RCA a644368a29978ede6: NOT_INTRODUCED, third-party Tilion browser-provider failure. First-bad boundary: Tilion answered no CDP input for the agent's request_payment_card step (worker.log:1379), then closed the CDP socket with code 1000 and again 1011 on reconnect (worker.log:1435, 1459), the pause failed closed with HTTP 500 (backend.log:2460) and BrowserSessionCloseError (agents/domains/spawn_browser_agent_v3/handler.py:12633-12637), so the payment-card request was never created. The unrelated browser-smoke task in the same run shows the identical timeline to the second (provider last reply 33.1 s before 12:09:20.1, close code=1000 at 12:09:33.43, code=1011 at 12:09:36.4, backend close 500), they share the Tilion session prefix sess_993d70 and CDP target 7B6D1EC62A7D, and Tilion POST /v1/session returned 502 at 12:08:55.8, 12:09:35.8 and 12:10:46.2 and timed out once in the same window. This PR's source delta from the previous smoke (826c8cf8b8) touches no runtime file; the float change is not on this path (no AgentCard use before the failure); no unreleased funds (0 cards, transfers or purchases). Not vendor-confirmed: no Tilion-side incident record was captured.
